name: Crownless Barracks
introDiscord:
The royal barracks remain packed with shields, helmets, practice
weapons, bunks, and several suits of armor still determined to maintain
military discipline.
introTwitch:
The royal barracks remain packed with shields, helmets, practice
weapons, bunks, and several suits of armor still determined to maintain
military discipline.

crownless-barracks-approach.prompt: Crownless Barracks opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A Crownless Knight marches from the training floor.

right.message:
An officer's footlocker contains Star Candies instead of socks.

Superior military logistics.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle sits beside a practice dummy:

'Training report:

Dummy defeated.

Dummy did not fight back.

Victory still valid.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

crownless-barracks-depths.prompt: Deeper within Crownless Barracks, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A weapons rack hides a little lockbox full of Star Candies.

right.message: A Crownless Knight challenges you beside the sparring ring.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath a wooden practice sword.

Shizuki wrote:

'Knight training lesson one:

dramatic stance.

Lesson two:

Glimmer stop laughing.'

crownless-barracks-threshold.prompt: Near Empty Helm Hall, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: An old infirmary cabinet still contains restorative salts.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message:
A ceremonial helmet contains Star Candies.

Helmet snacks.

forward.message: A Crownless Knight guards Empty Helm Hall.

boss-antechamber.name: Empty Helm Hall
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every empty helmet in the Hall turns toward the same armored figure.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every empty helmet in the Hall turns toward the same armored figure.

Its own helmet is missing.

Somehow this makes it more intimidating.

Use /yes to enter or /no to postpone graduation from royal
knight school.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every empty helmet in the Hall turns toward the same armored figure.

Its own helmet is missing.

Somehow this makes it more intimidating.

Use !yes to enter or !no to postpone graduation from royal
knight school.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Empty Helm Hall. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Castellan kneels.

Shizuki's training report can officially be amended:

'Real knight defeated.

Training program wildly successful.'
